verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of bulk action is Gemini's Organize feature, which can act on multiple emails at once, for example deleting them or adding labels. That is a natural-language route to bulk labeling, not a documented multi-select of conversations. Filters (gmail-docs-15) automate labeling of incoming mail and are an adjacent feature, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented checkbox or select-all multi-selection of conversations, bulk archive, bulk mark-done/read, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke

citations.quote: Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
